P4513.corridor_notes: This GEM row (P4513, 'South Loop pipeline (Wenshan-Honghe-Pu'er, Baoshan-Lincang)') appears to bundle TWO non-contiguous legs under one segment: (1) a southeast/south-central Yunnan corridor Wenshan-Honghe-Pu'er, and (2) a western Yunnan corridor Baoshan-Lincang near the Myanmar border. These are not geographically adjacent (separated by ~400+ km across multiple intervening prefectures) and cannot be a single continuous pipe; the 83.13 km LengthMergedKm on the sheet is far too short for either full corridor (e.g. the already-operating Mengzi-Wenshan Branch, P4509, alone is 121 km) and likely reflects only one short sub-piece of one leg, not the whole bundle. The start/end anchors above represent the BETTER-SOURCED of the two legs (Wenshan-Honghe), used as a representative pair per instructions; they do NOT represent the Baoshan-Lincang leg, which has no anchor coordinates with refs (see researcher_notes/blockers). A route candidate should NOT be drawn as one straight Wenshan-to-Baoshan line; this bundling itself may warrant a data-quality flag on the GEM row (splitting into two rows) independent of route-drawing.
P4513.researcher_notes:
LEG 1 — Wenshan-Honghe-Pu'er (南环线，文山-红河-普洱段): Honghe Prefecture Energy Bureau's 2024 annual performance self-evaluation report explicitly names a project '南环线（文山—红河段）...天然气管道项目...已完成主体方案编制上报集团公司审查' (South Ring Line, Wenshan-Honghe section... natural gas pipeline project... has completed the master scheme and submitted it to the group company [PipeChina] for review) — i.e. still in design/pre-approval planning, consistent with GEM's 'proposed' status. Source: https://www.hh.gov.cn/info/11481/1174302.htm (verified). The source only names the two prefecture-level endpoints 文山 (Wenshan) and 红河 (Honghe) — no township/county/station-level detail or route document was found despite extensive searching (in Chinese, targeting 环评/竣工/验收/分输站 terminology). I geocoded 文山市 (the Wenshan prefecture seat, sharing the exact prefecture name) as the start anchor. For 'Honghe' I used 蒙自市 (Mengzi City), the Honghe prefecture's administrative seat, as the best available proxy — NOTE this is an inference: the source literally says '红河' which could mean the whole prefecture rather than specifically Mengzi city, and there is also a distinct place called 红河县 (Honghe County) elsewhere in the prefecture that is NOT the same as Mengzi. Flag this ambiguity for whoever draws the candidate route. Pu'er (普洱) is NOT confirmed as part of this specific named sub-project — the only supporting hint is that Yunnan's 14th-five-year urban gas plan (云南省城镇燃气发展十四五规划, zfcxjst.yn.gov.cn) notes Pu'er's planned 北部门站 (North gate station, Simao district) as contingent on future trunk-line routing ('需根据长输管线敷设确定'), consistent with an unbuilt trunk feeding Pu'er, but this is not a named 南环线 reference and was not independently verified as connected to this specific project. Only ONE independent source was found for the Wenshan-Honghe leg's existence/status (the Honghe energy bureau report); this does not meet the usual 2-source corroboration bar, so confidence should be treated as medium/low despite resolution having coordinates+ref for both ends.

LEG 2 — Baoshan-Lincang (保山-临沧段): NO verifiable source was found for a pipeline project specifically named or described as running from Baoshan to Lincang, despite extensive Chinese-language searching (南环线 保山 临沧, 保山至临沧, 保山—临沧 天然气管道, EIA/环评 filings, Baoshan and Lincang municipal 'major project' lists, PipeChina Yunnan branch EIA document repository at rise.cnpc.com.cn). What DOES exist and is well-documented, but is a DIFFERENT already-tracked GEM pipeline, is the '临沧支线' (Lincang Branch): Phase I runs Nanjian County (Dali Prefecture) → Yunxian County → Fengqing (both Lincang Prefecture), 131.8 km, built 2019-2020 and largely complete/operational by the May-2020 report (source: https://www.china5e.com/news/news-1089467-1.html, verified) — this matches GEM's own P4501 'Dali–Lincang Branch (Phase I)' (status: operating, 131.80 km) in the local GGIT gas CSV snapshot. GEM also separately tracks P4505 'Lincang Fengqing–Lincang Shuangjiang Branch (Phase II)' (proposed, 172 km, continuing within Lincang from Fengqing) and P4500 'Baoshan–Nujiang Branch' (proposed, 120 km — a DIFFERENT corridor, Baoshan to Nujiang, not Lincang). None of these three rows is literally 'Baoshan to Lincang'; there is a real geographic/administrative gap between Baoshan and the existing Lincang-branch network (which enters from Dali/Nanjian, not from Baoshan). It is plausible P4513's 'Baoshan-Lincang' descriptor is either (a) a genuinely separate, not-yet-documented future connector directly linking the Baoshan trunk-line junction south to the Lincang branch network, or (b) an inaccurate/loose GEM label that may be conflating with the already-tracked Dali-Lincang or Baoshan-Nujiang branches. For reference only (NOT sourced, NOT verified, do not use for route-drawing without a source): geocoded 隆阳区 (Longyang District, Baoshan's urban seat) at lon 99.1645127 / lat 25.1241686, and 临翔区 (Linxiang District, Lincang's urban seat) at lon 100.0819288 / lat 23.8968236 — both via nominatim, informational placeholders only.

Duplicate check: no exact duplicate of P4513 itself found. Adjacent/nearby existing Yunnan Gas Pipeline Network rows worth cross-referencing when this row is next reviewed: P4509 'Mengzi–Wenshan Branch' (operating, 121 km — covers part of the same Wenshan-Honghe axis already, though under a different, already-operating segment), P6031 'Honghe Branch' (operating, 209 km), P4500/P4501/P4505 (the Baoshan-Nujiang and Dali-Lincang-area branches described above). None is a clean 1:1 duplicate of either P4513 leg, but the overlap in corridor with P4509/P6031 (Wenshan-Honghe leg) is close enough that a human reviewer should double check P4513 isn't simply a stale/duplicate listing of infrastructure GEM already tracks elsewhere before a route is drawn.
P4513.blockers: Two separate research gaps: (1) The Baoshan-Lincang leg has ZERO verifiable sources despite extensive searching (Baoshan/Lincang municipal government project lists, PipeChina Yunnan branch EIA filings, provincial gas plans) — only adjacent, already-GEM-tracked infrastructure (P4500, P4501, P4505) was found, none of which is literally a Baoshan-Lincang pipe. (2) The Wenshan-Honghe leg has only ONE independent source (a Honghe prefecture government budget/performance report) naming the project and confirming its planning-stage status, at prefecture level only (no township/station/route-level detail); this falls short of the usual 2-independent-source corroboration bar and the 'finest sourced level' target. The 'Honghe' endpoint's exact referent (Mengzi city vs. the wider prefecture vs. a different county) is inferred, not confirmed. Pu'er's inclusion in this named leg is unconfirmed. This session's WebSearch tool budget (200 calls) was exhausted mid-task; further Chinese-language search engines (Baidu, Bing, 360, DuckDuckGo) were attempted directly via curl but were blocked by captcha/anti-bot measures, so additional search avenues were not fully exhausted — a follow-up session with a fresh search budget could plausibly find more, especially for the Baoshan-Lincang leg.

P4955.corridor_notes: This GEM row/segment is confirmed to be specifically the 独山-平塘段 (Dushan-Pingtang section) of the larger 独山-平塘-罗甸天然气支线管道工程 (Dushan-Pingtang-Luodian branch pipeline project) — sources explicitly parenthesize '(独山-平塘段)' when naming the project, and describe it as ending at the boundary of/entering Pingtang County, i.e. it does NOT extend to Luodian. Gas source: the branch connects to the Sino-Myanmar (China-Myanmar) gas pipeline within Dushan County via a separate feeder (see duplicate-check note below), then runs from a Dushan-side gate/distribution station near Yangfeng (former Yangfeng Township, absorbed into Baiquan Town in a July 2013 administrative merger along with Chengguan Town and Yaosuo Township — per Baidu Baike '羊凤乡' entry) across the county line into Pingtang County. The Dushan gov site (dushan.gov.cn) explicitly groups three components of Dushan's natural-gas 'county-to-county' (县县通) build-out: (1) 贵州天然气管网独山天然气支线 (the Dushan branch, = GEM P4954, 11.55km, Dagang Village to Dushan), (2) 独山-平塘-罗甸天然气支线项目(独山-平塘段) (this row, P4955, 15.20km per GEM / reported as ~17.3km new pipe in one secondary source — the discrepancy is unresolved but both describe the same Dushan-Pingtang leg), and (3) 天然气门站 (a gate station) — identified by name as 羊凤天然气门站, which completed acceptance/registration Aug 2023 and reportedly began commissioning June 2023. Design specs from search snippets (not independently re-verified against a primary PDF): L360N steel pipe, DN323.9mm, 6.3 MPa design pressure, ~1.5 × 10^8 m³/year design capacity, ~120 million yuan investment, National Pipeline Group Southwest Pipeline Co. (国家管网集团西南管道公司) as builder. Straight-line distance between the geocoded start (Yangfeng) and end (Pingtang county seat) points is ~15km, consistent with the sheet's 15.20km LengthMergedKm and giving reasonable confidence the two points bracket the real corridor, though the pipeline's actual routing along roads/terrain will differ from a straight line and the true terminus may be short of the county seat itself.
P4955.researcher_notes: P4955 is NOT a duplicate of P4954 (Dagang Village–Dushan County, 11.55km, operating) — that row is the separate 独山天然气支线 (Dushan branch) that feeds gas IN to Dushan from the 47# valve chamber on the Sino-Myanmar pipeline; P4955 is the onward Dushan-Pingtang leg. Checked the GGIT snapshot for other Guizhou rows mentioning Pingtang/Luodian/Dushan: P4989 ('Sino-Myanmar Fuquan Branch Pipeline 47# Valve Chamber' to 'Luodian', 110km, construction) and P4991 (Wangmo to Luodian, 80km, proposed) both reach Luodian but via routes that do NOT mention Pingtang and start from a different valve chamber — these look like a separate corridor into Luodian, not a continuation of this Dushan-Pingtang segment, so no duplicate flag was set for those either, but a human reviewer assembling the full 独山-平塘-罗甸 corridor may want to check whether P4989's routing actually passes through/near Pingtang. Could not find a Pingtang-side EIA (环评) filing, a named station on the Pingtang side, or a more specific township than the county itself despite multiple targeted Chinese-language searches (羊凤天然气门站 location, 平塘 分输站/门站/首站, 独山至平塘 走向/途经乡镇, Pingtang county administrative-division cross-checks against 者密镇/通州镇/金盆街道). The existing sheet EndLocation 'Pingtang County' could not be sharpened beyond county level with verifiable sourcing.
P4955.blockers: End-point precision: only county-level ('Pingtang County') is sourced; no station name, township, or EIA route description was found on the Pingtang side despite multiple search passes (session's web-search budget was exhausted before further attempts, e.g. trying 首站/分输站 naming patterns or the county government's own site directly). P4957.corridor_notes: P4957 ('Main Line Zunyi-Bijie') is documented in its own GEM ResearcherNotes as a segment of the larger 遵义至赫章天然气管道 (Zunyi-Hezhang Gas Pipeline), a 310.6km, RMB 1.255bn provincial 'county-to-county' branch trunk built by Guizhou/Bijie Kunlun Natural Gas Co. (贵州昆仑天然气有限公司/毕节昆仑天然气有限公司), approved Feb 2015, construction started Aug 2015. Confirmed route order (both nyj.guizhou.gov.cn-sourced prose and the thepaper.cn acceptance article) runs 播州区 (Bozhou District, Zunyi) → 金沙县 (Jinsha County) → 大方县 (Dafang County) → 七星关区 (Qixingguan District, the seat of Bijie City) → 赫章县 (Hezhang County). P4957's own name/notes restrict its scope to the Zunyi-to-Qixingguan (i.e. Zunyi-to-Bijie) portion of that corridor, not the full line to Hezhang. First phase (遵义南输气站 [Zunyi South Gas Transmission Station] to 大方6号阀室 [Dafang No.6 valve room], 137km) went into trial operation/production at a June 4, 2018 ceremony at the Jinsha Clean Gas Distribution Station in Anlo Township, Jinsha County; the full 310.6km line passed formal completion acceptance May 17-18, 2022, with the inspection team visiting three checkpoints along the route: 播州区2号阀室 (Bozhou District No.2 valve room, near the Zunyi/start end), 七星关区清管分输站 (Qixingguan District pigging/distribution station), and a Hezhang geological-hazard point (赫章HZ002号桩地灾点, near the far end, outside P4957's scope). Within Qixingguan District specifically, a 2024 land-acquisition notice confirms the pipeline right-of-way crosses four townships in this order as listed: 岔河镇亦乐村 (Yile Village, Chahe Township), 阴底彝族苗族白族乡路朗村 (Lulang Village, Yindi Yi-Miao-Bai Autonomous Township), 杨家湾镇发达村 (Fada Village, Yangjiawan Township), and 朱昌镇八亩村 (Bamu Village, Zhuchang Township) — but the notice does not state which of these hosts 七星关区清管分输站, so the endpoint here is geocoded at the district level rather than to one specific township.
P4957.researcher_notes: Likely overlap flag, not a confirmed duplicate: GEM already carries P6002 ('Guizhou Gas Pipeline Network' / SegmentName 'Zunyi-Hezhang Gas Pipeline', operating, StartProvince/EndProvince Guizhou/Guizhou), cited to https://www.bijie.gov.cn/bm/bjsnyj/dt/bmdt/202205/t20220519_74723533.html — a May 19, 2022 Bijie municipal government post whose dateline (one day after the May 17-18, 2022 completion-acceptance meeting I found independently via thepaper.cn) strongly suggests it is a local republish of the SAME completion-acceptance story, i.e. P6002 = the full 310.6km Zunyi-Hezhang trunk end-to-end. P4957's own pre-existing ResearcherNotes explicitly call it 'a segment of the Zunyi-Hezhang Gas Pipeline,' i.e. P4957 appears to be intended as a sub-segment (Zunyi-to-Qixingguan/Bijie portion only) carved out of the same physical line that P6002 represents at full length. Whether this is legitimate segment-vs-whole-line modeling (fine, if P6002 has no route of its own and is just a network-level rollup) or true geometry duplication (a problem, if P6002 is meant to carry its own full-length route) could not be determined from this task's scope — flagging P6002 for a human to check its own RouteAccuracy/geometry status before both rows are drawn. Both P4957's Qixingguan-side endpoint sourcing and P6002's own citation independently point to the same physical corridor, which is expected given the stated segment relationship, not treated as two independent corroborating sources for P4957's specific claims. The existing sheet reference for P4957 (https://archive.org/details/screenshot-2023-03-16-at-2.54.37-pm_202303, an archive.org screenshot page) was reviewed but not used: it is a generic Internet Archive item-detail page with no extractable pipeline-specific content, and independent primary/news sourcing (thepaper.cn completion-acceptance article, provincial 环保 EIA notice, Qixingguan district land-acquisition notices) was readily available and stronger. Two additional candidate sources that would have let me confirm '遵义南输气站' (Zunyi South Gas Transmission Station) by name as the literal origin station, and '大方6号阀室' as the first-phase terminus, could not be verified: 贵州省能源局/贵州省人民政府 (nyj.guizhou.gov.cn) 404'd with no Wayback snapshot available, and an in-en.com mirror of the same story 403'd. In their absence I used '播州区2号阀室,' independently confirmed via the verified thepaper.cn acceptance article, as the best-sourced named station near the start; this is corroborated at the district level by the Sept 2015 sthj.guizhou.gov.cn EIA notice, which locates the project in '遵义县' — the pre-Dec-2016 name for what is now 播州区 (Bozhou District).

P6229.researcher_notes: Strong MULTI_BRANCH result: 5 distinct legs sourced, 4 of them (Tacheng, Altay, Ili, Bortala) from official Xinjiang prefecture/autonomous-region government (.gov.cn) sites or Xinhua/state media, plus the Karamay-Wangjiagou trunk independently corroborating GEM's own pre-existing StartLocation/EndLocation. GEM's Wiki links this row to 'Tarim Basin Rim Gas Pipeline Network' (塔里木盆地周边天然气管网). IMPORTANT: this program's southern projects appear to have been substantially re-branded/consolidated by 2024 under the name '气化南疆天然气管道工程' (Gasification of Southern Xinjiang), which GEM tracks as a SEPARATE row, P7448 (2108 km, construction, started 2024-03-29) — see duplicate/overlap note in researcher_notes. The branches sourced here are: (1) the 气化南疆 west trunk (Kuqa-Bachu, identical corridor to P7448's west branch — kept here too since it is explicitly the shared backbone P6230's 'Aksu' project component connects to), (2) a Kashgar-prefecture local utility branch reaching Tumushuke City/48th Regiment off the Bachu tie-in point (could not source a verifiable URL for this specific segment — see blockers), and (3) a newly-started (Dec 2025) Hotan-prefecture branch reaching the existing CNPC Hotan gas station via Yecheng/Pishan/Kunyu/Moyu — this is presumably one of the 9 original 'southern projects' still being built out as of this research date (2026-07-30). P6230.researcher_notes: STRONG SUSPECTED OVERLAP WITH P7448 — flagging for human adjudication rather than setting duplicate_of unilaterally: P6230 ('9 branches', 2113.5 km, proposed, sourced only to the 2023-07 announcement, no RouteType/route) and P7448 ('气化南疆', 2108 km, construction since 2024-03, much more richly documented — capacity, fuel source, an explicit note about the corridor becoming an 'O-shaped' ring) both (a) are explicitly described in official sources as components of the SAME parent program (南北疆天然气利民管道扩建工程), (b) cover the same southern-Xinjiang / Tarim-basin-rim geography (Kashgar/Aksu/Bazhou/Hotan), and (c) have near-identical total lengths (2113.5 vs 2108 km). It looks very likely that the 2023-announced '9 southern projects' were consolidated/rebranded into the 气化南疆 program by the time construction started in 2024, i.e. P6230 may be an earlier, less-developed snapshot of what P7448 now represents in more detail — but I could not find a document that explicitly equates the two, and a Kashgar-prefecture and Hotan-prefecture branch (found here) are not mentioned in any of the 气化南疆-specific sourcing for P7448, so P6230's scope may be somewhat broader than P7448's. P7448.corridor_notes: 气化南疆天然气管道工程 (Gasification of Southern Xinjiang) is explicitly described (GEM's own ResearcherNotes, corroborated by xinjiang.gov.cn) as turning the existing 'C'-shaped southern-Xinjiang gas network into an 'O'-shaped closed ring around the Tarim Basin, connecting Kashgar, Aksu, and Bazhou (巴州) prefectures — 9 counties/cities total, raising daily peak supply from 27 to 58 million m3. Total length 2108 km, built in 3 batches; Batch 1 (2024, ~616-1126 km depending on source/date) comprises the two named trunks sourced here: a WEST line from Kuqa (near the Kela-Keshen gas field, Tarim Oilfield's main gas source, matching GEM's FuelSource) through Xinhe/Wensu/Alar/Aksu/Kalping to Bachu County, and an EAST line from Lunnan Town (on the existing West-East Gas Pipeline, Luntai County) to Korla's Shangku industrial park. A 2025-03-10 groundbreaking ceremony for '英买力至三岔' (west) + '轮南至上库工业园区' (east) — combined 510 km — was held simultaneously in Kashgar and Aksu, described as the SAME two lines. Batches 2-3 (reaching Kashgar/Hotan further out, closing the ring) are being built by prefecture-level projects that GEM tracks separately as P6230 (see that row's researcher_notes for a flagged overlap concern). OSM carries actual traced geometry for part of the east trunk — see map_or_vector.

P7448.researcher_notes: Solid MULTI_BRANCH result for Batch 1 (the only fully-named, fully-sourced batch): 2 named trunk lines, each corroborated by 2+ independent sources (aksxw.com regional news + xj.chinadaily.com.cn), with the east trunk further corroborated by matching OSM-traced geometry (see map_or_vector) — a strong signal this segment is either built or far enough along to be surveyable. P5923.corridor_notes: This project (西二线、川气东送嘉兴联通工程) is a short point-form interconnection facility, not a long-haul linear transmission pipeline. Per the 2023-08-10 land-use pre-review notice (jiashan.gov.cn), '项目起点为天凝镇洪南村西二线管道，终点为天凝镇洪南村川气东送管道，全长0.8公里' — i.e. both the nominal start (tie-in to West-East Line 2 / 西二线上海支干线嘉兴-甪直联络线) and end (tie-in to 川气东送) are in the same village, 0.8km apart. Per the 2024-01-28 completion/environmental-acceptance notice (zjhby.com), a new interconnection station (嘉善联络站) was built at 浙江省嘉兴市嘉善县天凝镇洪南村, with filtering/metering/flow-regulation facilities and bidirectional flow capability, design pressure 10MPa, design capacity 80×10^8 Nm3/a. Construction: demolished 75m of old West-2-branch pipe, built 288.43m of new DN1016mm inlet/outlet pipe to the station; demolished 46m of old 川气东送 pipe, built 365.73m of new DN1016mm inlet/outlet pipe to the station. Total investment ¥199.13 million. The sasac.gov.cn article (2024-06-17, cited in prior ResearcherNotes) documents system-wide bidirectional throughput context (West-East pipeline system surpassing 500 billion m3 delivered to the Yangtze Delta) but does not name this specific site.
P5923.researcher_notes: SPECIAL NOTE per task instructions: GEM's StartLocation=EndLocation was flagged as a likely data defect, but sourced evidence indicates this is NOT actually a defect — this is genuinely a point interconnection facility (a single village/station where two trunk lines are tied together), so start and end are legitimately the same physical location (within the station footprint, tie-in points on opposite sides).
